title: Responsible AI, Model Documentation, Dataset Documentation, and Evaluation Foundations

sources.notes: NIST AI Risk Management Framework identity for voluntary AI risk management, trustworthiness considerations, AI RMF 1.0, playbook, roadmap, crosswalks, AI resource center, and generative AI profile; PDFs, playbook pages, profiles, comments, translations, and linked resources remain boundary-checked.
NIST AI RMF Generative AI Profile identity for generative-AI risk management; PDF body, tables, appendices, figures, and linked assets remain boundary-checked.

Model Cards for Model Reporting identity for intended-use documentation, benchmarked evaluation across conditions and groups, evaluation procedure disclosure, and transparent model reporting; paper PDFs, figures, examples, cards, and linked assets remain boundary-checked.

Datasheets for Datasets identity for documenting dataset motivation, composition, collection process, recommended uses, operating characteristics, and transparency/accountability; paper PDFs, templates, examples, and linked assets remain boundary-checked.

HELM identity for holistic language-model evaluation as a living benchmark with broad coverage, incompleteness recognition, multi-metric measurements, standardization, and accessible data/analysis; benchmark data, model outputs, UI assets, generated pages, and linked resources remain boundary-checked.

Language Model Evaluation Harness identity for configurable evaluation tasks, CLI subcommands, model backends, Open LLM Leaderboard tasks, multimodal prototypes, API model support, prompt configuration, and output post-processing; repository content, task YAMLs, code, docs, datasets, results, and releases remain boundary-checked.
